create_prop_placer: create a PropPlacer to place composer Entity props at specified positions and orientations in a MuJoCo physics simulation
build_prop_placer_with_settle: build a PropPlacer with settle_physics enabled to advance simulation steps until prop joint velocities and accelerations settle below thresholds
review_prop_collision_detection: review the PropPlacer _has_collisions_with_prop method to understand how geom contact distances are checked for collision detection
refactor_rejection_sampling: refactor the PropPlacer rejection sampling loop to customize max_attempts_per_prop or adjust position and quaternion variation distributions
test_contact_parameter_caching: test the PropPlacer _disable_and_cache_contact_parameters and _restore_contact_parameters methods to verify contype and conaffinity are correctly saved and restored
